$comment: Fixed OpenCode workflow scenario definitions (PR-trace remediation plan, common validation baseline). These SAME definitions are used before and after each affected phase. Offline deterministic fixtures only: every scenario runs against per-run disposable workspaces with NO model call, NO network, NO install, NO Git mutation and NO push. Any live execution requires the separately approved finite smoke envelope (plan lines 62-64). This file is scenario DEFINITION, not runtime proof of plugin hooks or worker budgets.

global_invariants.$comment_numeric_budget_ceilings: Aggregate token/monetary ceiling, per-run and whole-envelope wall deadlines, maximum actual HTTP attempts and the safe cancellation mechanism are deliberately unset: they require separate explicit approval (plan line 62) before any model run.

scenarios.title: Small simple edit with a known offline assertion
scenarios.description: A single deterministic text edit inside a fresh per-run disposable workspace, verified by an offline assertion on file content. No repository file is touched.
scenarios.offline_assertion: target file ends with the single appended fixed line and contains exactly one occurrence of it
scenarios.expected_outcome: edit applied; offline assertion passes; no side effects outside the per-run workspace

scenarios.title: Reproducible failing-test debugging with a known injected cause
scenarios.description: A synthetic test fails for exactly one known injected root cause inside the disposable workspace; the debug loop must locate that cause and reach the declared passing target without changing unrelated behavior.
scenarios.injected_cause: off-by-one boundary constant in a pure helper function
scenarios.passing_target: the synthetic test passes after correcting only the injected cause
scenarios.expected_outcome: failing test reproduced, root cause identified, only the injected cause corrected, passing target observed

scenarios.title: Reviewer finding fixed once, then unchanged-revision handoff with no duplicate review
scenarios.description: One relevant reviewer finding is fixed once; a handoff with an UNCHANGED relevant-scope revision must not trigger a duplicate review. A dependency/environment input is then deliberately changed to prove validation invalidation fires.
scenarios.unchanged_revision_rule: an unchanged relevant-scope revision (same worktree bytes, same index state, same allowlisted untracked files, same relevant dependency and environment inputs) must NOT be re-reviewed
scenarios.invalidation_trigger: change one relevant dependency/environment input so prior validation results must be treated as invalidated rather than reused
scenarios.expected_outcome: finding closed once; unchanged-revision handoff accepted without duplicate review; changed input invalidates prior validation

scenarios.title: Publication dry-run: expected state succeeds, mismatches stop with no push
scenarios.description: A fully synthetic publication preflight over fixture-local repositories: the expected state succeeds, while wrong root, wrong head, wrong destination or an unauthorized operation stops before any side effect. Push is never executed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: expected state passes; every stop path blocks before side effects; zero push operations performed
